description: This is a Java test source file for the class CohortMembership. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of various methods in CohortMembership, including date handling, comparison, equality, and sorting logic within the context of the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: CohortMembershipTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior and comparison logic of the CohortMembership class in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: isMembershipActive_shouldReturnTrueIfAsOfDateIsAfterStartDate
methods.description: Tests that a cohort membership is active when the date is after the start date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldReturnFalseIfStartDateIsAfterAsOfDate
methods.description: Tests that the membership is inactive when the test date is before the start date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldBeInactiveAsOfDateForVoidedMembership
methods.description: Verifies that a voided membership is inactive regardless of the date.

methods.name: isActive_shouldBeInclusiveOfStartAndEndDates
methods.description: Checks that start and end dates are inclusive in the activity status.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldCompareMembershipsForEquality
methods.description: Verifies that compareTo returns zero for two equal memberships.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldCompareBasedOnPatientId
methods.description: Confirms comparison order based on patient ID.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldSortByStartDate
methods.description: Checks sorting based on start date.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldFailIfStartOrEndDateDoNotMatch
methods.description: Verifies that comparison fails when start or end date mismatch.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldFailIfOneOfTheMembershipIsNotActive
methods.description: Ensures comparison considers active state.

methods.name: shouldReturnNegativeValueIfTheMembershipIsNotVoidedAndTheOtherIsAndTheyAreBothEnded
methods.description: Tests comparison logic when one membership is voided and both are ended.

methods.name: shouldReturnPositiveValueIfTheMembershipIsVoidedAndTheOtherIsNotAndTheyAreBothEnded
methods.description: Tests comparison when voicing status differs and memberships are ended.

methods.name: compareTo_shouldSort
methods.description: Verifies comprehensive sorting order of different membership states and dates.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnTrueIfObjectReferenceAreTheSame
methods.description: Checks that equality is true when comparing object to itself.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnFalseIfObjectIsNull
methods.description: Checks that equality comparison with null returns false.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnTrueIfStartDateEndDatePatientIdAreSameInBothObjects
methods.description: Verifies equality when start date, end date, and patient ID are identical.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnFalseIfEndDateAndPatientIdAreNotSameInBothObjects
methods.description: Verifies inequality when end date or patient ID differs.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnFalseIfOnlyStartDateOfOneObjectIsNull
methods.description: Checks inequality when only one start date is null.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnFalseIfOnlyEndDateOfOneObjectIsNull
methods.description: Checks inequality when only one end date is null.

methods.name: equal_shouldReturnTrueIfPatientIdIsEqualAndStarDateAndEndDateAreBothNull
methods.description: Verifies equality when IDs are equal and both dates are null.

methods.name: euqal_shouldPreventAddingTwoEqualObjectsToACollection
methods.description: Ensures that a set contains only one instance of equivalent objects.
